guides.title: Launch Day Prep
guides.subtitle: Get your console ready so you're playing the minute it unlocks.
guides.body:
## Before launch
- **Free up storage.** Big open-world games need a lot of space, and patches add more. Clear room well before launch day.
- **Update your console.** Install system updates now so they don't hold you up at midnight.
- **Turn on automatic downloads.** On PlayStation, enable Rest Mode downloads. On Xbox, use Energy Saving or Sleep with updates on.
- **Pre-load if you bought digital.** If pre-loading is offered, start it as soon as it opens.
## On launch night
- **Expect a day-one patch.** Leave time for it to download before you play.
- **Use a wired connection** if you can. It is usually faster and steadier than Wi-Fi.
- **Check the official site** for the exact unlock time in your region.

guides.title: What We Know So Far
guides.subtitle: The confirmed basics, with no rumors mixed in.
guides.body:
## The basics
- **Release:** November 19, 2026
- **Platforms:** PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S at launch
- **Setting:** Vice City and the surrounding state of Leonida, a fictional take on Florida
- **Leads:** Lucia and Jason, shown together in the trailers
## Not confirmed yet
Anything not listed above should be treated as unconfirmed. In the Home tab, rumors are always labeled RUMOR.

guides.title: How to Use This App
guides.subtitle: Countdown, timeline, guides and your personal tracker.
guides.body:
## Home
A live countdown, a launch-day reminder you can switch on, and a timeline of announcements. Each item is labeled **Official**, **Rumor** or **Community**.
## Guides
New guides are added after launch, with no app update needed. Pull down on any screen to refresh.
## Tracker
Tap items to check them off. Your progress is saved on your phone.
## Widget
Add the Launch Countdown widget to your Home Screen to see the days left at a glance.

missions.title: Island Dreams
missions.summary: Kenton, who runs a beach dive shop, offers Jason the use of his boat and scuba gear in exchange for guiding a group of tourists on a wreck dive.
steps: Meet Kenton at his Island Dreams shop by the beach.
Take the boat out to the marked spot offshore.
Put on the scuba gear at the back of the boat and dive in.
Lead the tourists through the underwater trench to the shipwreck.
Equip the **metal detector** from the weapon wheel and sweep the search area until it turns green.
Collect the treasure on the seabed.
Free the stuck diver at the wreck.
Deal with the **shark** on the way back using the harpoon gun.
Swim back up to the boat to finish.
tips: Keep an eye on the oxygen bar in the top-left corner.
Click **L3 / LS** to swim faster underwater.
The shark goes down quicker if you stay close, since harpoon shots drop off over distance.
You can return to wrecks later to look for more treasure, and Kenton's boat and gear stay available to you.
missions.rewards: Access to Kenton's shop, boat and diving gear

missions.title: Feng Shui
missions.summary: A low-key mission at Jason's house: Cal helps rearrange the living room, then the two unwind with some video games.
steps: After Island Dreams, wait for the text and head to Jason's house in Key Lento.
Go inside to start the mission, then sit on the couch.
Move the TV, coffee table, couch and chair to where Cal suggests.
Play **Tenebrae Lux** with Cal until it ends.
Play **Street Trash III** until it ends.
tips: It doesn't matter whether you accept the coffee table spot or keep moving it; the result is the same.
Neither video game can be won, so don't stress about your score. They end on their own.
